content: »Xɨka xewitɨ Yawé tuuru yetuirieni 'aixɨa memɨteyuxeiyanikɨ mawariyari, kanixatɨamɨkɨ 'aixɨa 'aneme tsepa mɨtituuru yatɨni tsepa mɨtiwakaxi.

Kemɨ'ane 'imikieri mɨyetuani mɨkɨ wakaxi muwaxitekieni mu'uyatsie peutimeni, mɨranutahakitɨretsie 'ixuriki tukiyari manuwe hɨxie. Hikɨ 'Aruni niwemama mawari wewiwamete, xuriya mekwewieme mawari taiyame 'aurie mepeyeurietɨkɨne.
Kemɨ'ane miyetuani Yawé hetsɨa, 'imikieri taipa kuaxiyariekame, 'ikɨ 'imikieri 'aixɨa memɨteyuxeiyanikɨ mawari pɨhɨkɨ: wiya meta kwinuri naime mɨ'eimatɨka piyetuirieni,
mumé muhuta wiyayari mi'eimatɨka, meta wiya katutsitɨana mieme, meta wiya nemaya heimana mɨkawere, mɨkɨ pɨrayehapanieni mumé muhuta yɨnɨkame.
Hɨkɨ 'Aruni niwemama naime 'ikɨ mawari taiyametsie mekatenititaiyakuni, mawari taiyariyari heima matita'a muyekatsie. Mɨkɨ mawari Yawé mɨyetuiriyarɨwa taipa mieme witsimu'ɨa kanihɨkɨtɨni.
»Xɨka mawari 'aixɨa memɨteyuxeiyanikɨ mɨyetuani tuuru hɨkɨtɨni, kemɨ'ane miyetuani Yawé kaniyetuiriemɨkɨ 'aixɨa 'aneme, tsepa mɨtiwakaxi yatɨni mɨtituuru.
Xɨka 'imikieri muxa hɨkɨtɨni, Yawé hɨxie xepiyetuani,
mu'uyatsie putimeni 'anake pimieni 'ixuriki tukiyari manuwe hɨxie. Hikɨ 'Aruni niwemama xuriyaya mawari taiyame 'aurie mepayeurietɨkɨne.

Kemɨ'ane mɨtiyetuani Yawé hetsɨa 'imikieri taipa kwaxiyariekame, 'ikɨ mawaritsie mieme yamɨtipaɨme pɨtihɨkɨtɨni: wiya meta kwaxieya naimime, (tsutɨanapaitɨ kanexitemɨkɨ), wiya meta kwinuri naime mɨ'eimatɨka piyetuirieni,
mumé muhuta wiyayari mi'eimatɨka, meta wiya katutsitɨana mieme, meta wiya nemaya heimana mɨkawere, mɨkɨ pɨrayehapanieni mumé muhuta yɨnɨkame.
Hikɨ mawari wewiwame mɨkɨ naime mawari taiyametsie katinititaiyamɨkɨ. Mɨkɨ 'ikwai kanihɨkɨtɨni, mawari taipa warɨkarietɨ Yawé hetsɨa mɨyetuiwa kanihɨkɨtɨni.
»Xɨka tsipu 'uka hɨkɨtɨni mawari 'imikieri mayanikɨ Yawé hɨxie piyetuani.
Mu'uyatsie putimeni, 'anake 'ixuriki tukiyari manuwe memanutakɨka hɨxie penutixiteni. Hikɨ 'Aruni niwemama xuriyaya mawari taiyame 'aurie mepayeurietɨkɨne.
Kemɨ'ane mɨtiyetuani Yawé hetsɨa 'imikieri taiyariyari, mɨkɨ pɨtihɨkɨtɨni: wiya meta kwinuri naime mɨ'eimatɨka piyetuirieni,
mumé muhuta wiyayari mi'eimatɨka, meta wiya katutsitɨana mieme, meta wiya nemaya heimana mɨkawere, mɨkɨ pɨrayehapanieni mumé muhuta yɨnɨkame.
Hikɨ mawari wewiwame naime mɨkɨ mawari taiyametsie katinititaiyamɨkɨ. Mɨkɨ 'imikieri taiyariyari Yawé minake witsimu'ɨa kanihɨkɨtɨni, mɨkɨ naitɨ wiya Yawé hetsɨa kanimiemetɨni.
»'Ikɨ kanihɨkɨtɨkamɨkɨ 'aitsika xexiɨyarima wahetsie mieme yamemɨtekahunikɨ, tsepa hakewa xemetiteni. Xuriya xepɨkakwa'ani meta wiya».
